text.p: Cleanup from flooding and wind damage continues on Okinawa and cleanup from severe flooding continues in northern Taiwan. Flooding is occurring in east central China, southwest to west of Shanghai. All of this has been caused by Winnie as it came in from the western Pacific. The storm has now dissipated as a tropical cyclone over land but plentiful tropical moisture continues to dump heavy rain over eastern China. Resulting flooding is damaging property and crops. Some of the rice crop may be lost in eastern China. The heaviest rain will end during the next 24 hours.
Tropical Storm Yule is expected to move northward, passing just east of Wake Island in the western Pacific during the next 24 hours. Minor to moderate wind and flood damage may occur on the island.
